acquisition_method.evidence: Data dependent MS/MS analysis was performed in top speed mode with a 2 sec. cycle time, during which precursors detected within the range of m/z 375 − 1500 were selected for activation in order of abundance.

alkylation_concentration.evidence: Briefly, the pellets were lysed, reduced and alkylated in a single step using a buffer containing 2% (w/v) SDC (sodium deoxycholate), 10 mM TCEP (Tris(2-carboxyethyl)phosphine hydrochloride), 40 mM CAA (chloroacetamide), 100 mMTrisHCl pH 8.0 and loaded into StageTip.

cleavage_agent.evidence: The lysates were diluted with 25 mMTris pH 8.5 containing 1 µg of trypsin.

collision_energy.evidence: HCD was performed using 28% normalized collision energy.

fragmentation_method.evidence: HCD was performed using 28% normalized collision energy.

mass_analyzer.evidence: Orbitrap detection was used for both MS1 and MS2 measurements at resolving powers of 120 K and 30 K (at m/z 200), respectively.
